results.title: Claude Haiku 5.5
results.text:
Latest. Released October 7, 2026.

For high-volume, latency-sensitive tasks such as classification, extraction, and routing

Model ID: `claude-haiku-5-5`

Context window: 1M tokens · Max output: 128K tokens · Input pricing: From $0.10 / MTok · Output pricing: From $0.50 / MTok

Announcement · What’s new · Migration guide

## Overview

Claude Haiku 5.5 is built for high-volume, latency-sensitive work such as classification, routing, extraction, and subagent tasks. It supports adaptive thinking with the effort parameter, a 1M token context window, and up to 128k output tokens. It uses the same newer tokenizer as Claude 4.7 and later models, so the same text counts as approximately 30% more tokens than on Claude Haiku 4.5. Its thinking blocks work only in the account that produced them, or in an account linked to it.

For code changes, see the migration guide. For model IDs, pricing, and limits, see the Claude Haiku 5.5 overview. For prompting guidance, see Prompting Claude Haiku 5.5.

What's new in Claude Haiku 5.5

## How it compares

| Model | Context | Max output | Price / MTok | Latency | Thinking | Default effort | Knowledge cutoff |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Claude Fable 5.1 | 1M | 128K | $10 / $50 | Slower | Adaptive (always on) | `high` | Jun 2026 |
| Claude Opus 5.5 | 1M | 128K | $4 / $20 | Moderate | Adaptive (always on) | `medium` | Jun 2026 |
| Claude Sonnet 5.5 | 1M | 128K | $2 / $10 | Fast | Adaptive | `high` | Jun 2026 |
| Claude Haiku 5.5 (this model) | 1M | 128K | From $0.10 / $0.50 | Fastest | Adaptive | `medium` | Jun 2026 |

- Context: 1M tokens is roughly 555k words or 2.5M Unicode characters on the current tokenizer (introduced with Claude Opus 4.7); models before it fit about 750k words in 1M tokens. 200k tokens is roughly 150k words.
- Max output: Synchronous Messages API limit. On the Message Batches API, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Opus 5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5, Claude Haiku 5.5, Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Opus 4.6, and Claude Sonnet 4.6 support up to 300k output tokens with the output-300k-2026-03-24 beta header.
- Price / MTok: Input / output, base price per million tokens. Batch API requests are 50% off; prompt caching reads cost 10% of the base input price (2.5% on Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1, 5% on Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Sonnet 5.5). See Pricing for the full list.
- Latency: Comparative latency, relative to the current lineup, as published in the models overview. Actual latency depends on prompt length, output length, and thinking effort.
- Thinking: Adaptive thinking lets the model decide how much to think, steered by effort. Extended thinking is the manual budget_tokens mode on earlier models.
- Default effort: The effort parameter’s default on the Claude API. Models without a value don’t support the parameter.
- Knowledge cutoff: Reliable knowledge cutoff: the date through which the model’s knowledge is most extensive and reliable.

Claude Haiku 5.5 is Anthropic's small, fast model for high-volume, cost-sensitive work such as summarization, subagents, and browser use. It succeeds Claude Haiku 4.5 with stronger coding, computer use, and knowledge work, and accepts text and image input with a 1M-token context window.

It is the first Haiku model with adjustable effort. Thinking is adaptive and on by default, with effort as the main lever for trading off depth, latency, and cost; it can be turned off at low, medium, and high effort.

## Which tier to use 

What each costs against standard in our data, and the job it is for.

Batch

The batch tier (claude-haiku-5.5:batch) is 50% cheaper than standard. Batch requests are queued and answered asynchronously, typically within 24 hours, so it suits work nobody is waiting on: evaluations, back-fills, bulk classification and tagging. Anything a user is waiting on belongs on the standard tier.

Aliases

"-latest" names point at whichever release the vendor currently serves, listed at the same price as standard. The price can change under you when the alias moves, so budget against a pinned name.

Direct or through a reseller

Through OpenRouter, claude-haiku-5.5 is the same price as buying direct. A reseller is worth it for one bill across vendors and automatic fallback; buy direct for the vendor's own batch, caching and rate-limit terms.

Claude Haiku 5.5: API ID, Pricing Tiers & Setup

# Claude Haiku 5.5

Anthropic Oct 7, 2026 Major release Active

Use claude-haiku-5-5 for high-volume classification, extraction and routing. Price each request by prompt length: crossing 100,000 input tokens raises both input and output rates. Check the examples and setup steps before estimating a batch.

## Choose this model for a task

Anthropic positions Haiku 5.5 for high-volume, latency-sensitive work, including classification, extraction, routing and subagent tasks. A useful first evaluation uses representative records with known answers, checks missing fields and wrong labels, and counts retries. Lower per-token prices alone do not establish the cheapest successful workflow.

### API identifier and first checks

`claude-haiku-5-5`

1. Confirm your account and platform can access this ID using the official Models API.
2. Follow the official API quickstart with a small task. Check the response, usage and errors before processing a dataset.
3. The official model page recommends omitting temperature, top_p and top_k, and documents adaptive thinking with effort control. Its tokenizer differs from Haiku 4.5, so recount the same prompt instead of reusing an old token estimate. Use a small sample before sending the complete dataset.

### Estimate a request, not just a token rate

Sources reviewed October 13, 2026: official model specification · official pricing. This is a documentation review and editorial evaluation plan; no authenticated API call, client benchmark or subscription entitlement was tested here.

## What changed?

- Pricing: $0.10/$0.50 per 1M in/out for prompts up to 100K tokens; $0.50/$2.50 above 100K; prompt caching saves up to 90%, batch 50%. Roughly 75% cheaper to run than Haiku 4.5 on average (API price down 90% for the ~90% of requests under 100K); Box measured +11 points over Haiku 4.5 at about half the latency
- First Haiku with adaptive thinking / effort controls; 1M-token context, 128K max output; API id claude-haiku-5-5
- Breaking changes vs Haiku 4.5: manual extended thinking (budget_tokens) returns 400; adaptive thinking is on by default (responses can begin with thinking blocks); a new tokenizer counts slightly more tokens per task — migration guide published
- GA everywhere: selectable on Claude apps (web/iOS/Android) for Free through Enterprise plans; Claude API, Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud, Microsoft Foundry and Claude Code; Claude Python/TypeScript SDKs add browser-use and computer-use tool classes in beta
- Positioning: summarization, classification, routing, compaction, subagents and computer/browser automation; works alongside Fable or Opus as a cost-efficient subagent for well-defined tasks
- Same-day value drops across the lineup: Sonnet 5.5 cache reads cut 50% to $0.10/1M (about 20% cheaper on most agentic tasks); Max/Team plans gain monthly API credits ($100 / $200 / up to $500 pooled per team)
- Safety: cybersecurity safeguards more restrictive than Haiku 4.5 but less restrictive than Sonnet 5.5 (defensive tasks allowed, penetration testing still blocked); biology safeguards aligned with Sonnet 5 / 5.5 and Opus 5
